_doc: Calibration set for skills/work/scripts/rule-calibrate.ts. Paths are repo-relative. layout 'files': every file in the case dir goes to the extractor, plan.md as --plan. layout 'diff': before/ is committed in a temp repo, after/ is laid over it, .fixture suffixes are stripped. A case with 'base' is replayed as a diff in either layout: base is committed, the case dir is laid over it, and diff-scoped rules see only the changed lines. A case with 'source' is a real excerpt copied 2026-10-02; the note lives here because every file in a case dir reaches the extractor.
